ns2:course.label: Instrumentation and Test Lab
ns2:course.description: Preparation for experimental projects; mechanical and electrical instruments; mechanical testing of materials; experimental stress analysis and photoelastic methods. Prerequisite: SE 310; concurrent registration in SE 311.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: SE 310; concurrent registration in SE 311.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for a Lecture, Laboratory and Laboratory-Discussion section.
